title: Daniel Unsealed
notes: Strong, dense opening that asserts the seal-and-unseal frame, the dual jubilee/seventy-seventy counts, and the two-decree structure without hedging. Letter re-readings are cleanly marked and the marriage-covenant link lands with force. Residual defects are mostly house-style sentence opens (But/That/And) and a few presenter cues (Mark the verb, Now read, Now count). One tangled relative clause on KJV tenses vs. letters needs a short clarity fix. No AI stock vocabulary, no doctrine rewrites required, and scripture blocks are left untouched.

This short closing chunk asserts the unsealed counts with density and cleanly integrates the Matthew quotation plus dual print/non-print endings. Strengths include tight prose, preserved markup, and a law-positive close that points forward without hedging. Issues are limited to a clear house-style sentence-open violation in the print branch, two spelled-out count numbers that violate the digits rule, and one mild presenter-style imperative. No quote corruption, doctrine drift, or AI vocabulary appears. Surgical fixes restore compliance while leaving voice and claims intact.

proposals.old: But read carefully what the seventy must contain: all of Jeremiah's words brought upon that land — __“even all that is written in this book”__ (Jeremiah 25:13) — and Babylon made a desolation for ever.
proposals.new: Read carefully what the seventy must contain: all of Jeremiah's words brought upon that land — __“even all that is written in this book”__ (Jeremiah 25:13) — and Babylon made a desolation for ever.
proposals.summary: Drop leading But from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that open with And/But/That.

proposals.old: That places 2026-2027 in the *third year* of Hezekiah's sign — two fallow years, __“and in the third year *sow ye, and reap*”__ (Isaiah 37:30) — and the third is the year of going up: __“on the *third day* thou shalt *go up unto the house of the LORD*”__ (2 Kings 20:5).
proposals.new: This places 2026-2027 in the *third year* of Hezekiah's sign — two fallow years, __“and in the third year *sow ye, and reap*”__ (Isaiah 37:30) — and the third is the year of going up: __“on the *third day* thou shalt *go up unto the house of the LORD*”__ (2 Kings 20:5).
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not open with That; This keeps the same deictic force without the violation.

proposals.old: That count runs from the covenant itself, sealed in 1876 BC, four hundred thirty years to the selfsame day before the Exodus (Exodus 12:40-41) — and if the reign of a thousand years is its final millennium, the reign opens 3,900 years in: the very year the seventieth jubilee closed.
proposals.new: This count runs from the covenant itself, sealed in 1876 BC, four hundred thirty years to the selfsame day before the Exodus (Exodus 12:40-41) — and if the reign of a thousand years is its final millennium, the reign opens 3,900 years in: the very year the seventieth jubilee closed.
proposals.rationale: Same house-style ban on That-openings; This preserves reference to the second reading.

proposals.old: And four hundred ninety years from that second decree is where the reading says the times end, __“in tribulation.”__
proposals.new: Four hundred ninety years from that second decree is where the reading says the times end, __“in tribulation.”__
proposals.summary: Drop leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that open with And.

proposals.summary: Replace director cue with plain assertion.
proposals.rationale: Mark the verb is a forbidden presenter staging cue; The verbs differ keeps the structural role and author density.

proposals.old: Now read the whole verse the second time through:
proposals.new: Read the whole verse the second time through:
proposals.summary: Strip Now from the re-reading cue.
proposals.rationale: Now read is residual director staging; the bare imperative matches the chapter’s other Read the letters again markers.

proposals.old: Now count, a sym:sym-day[day] for a sym:sym-year[year].
proposals.new: Count a sym:sym-day[day] for a sym:sym-year[year].
proposals.summary: Strip Now from the counting cue.
proposals.rationale: Now count is presenter staging; the bare imperative preserves markup and force.

proposals.old: Daniel's twelfth chapter seals the timeline — and the King James points the tenses forward that the letters point back:
proposals.new: Daniel's twelfth chapter seals the timeline — and the King James points the tenses forward while the letters point back:
proposals.summary: Untangle the relative clause on tenses.
proposals.rationale: Forward that the letters point back is tangled; while restores the clear opposition without adding words or softening the claim.

proposals.old: The blessing has a second number: add the thousand three hundred thirty-five, and the count runs to the spring of 2028 — the abomination made desolate, and the waiting ones arrived.
proposals.new: The blessing has a second number: add the 1,335, and the count runs to the spring of 2028 — the abomination made desolate, and the waiting ones arrived.
proposals.summary: Render the 1335 count as digits per house style.
proposals.rationale: House style requires digits for counts; the spelled form is the only defect in an otherwise clean sentence.

proposals.old: Set that end against the seventy jubilees and the second decree's four hundred ninety, and the three counts close on the same few years — the tribulation of the times’ end that the ninth chapter named.
proposals.new: With that end set against the seventy jubilees and the second decree's 490, the three counts close on the same few years — the tribulation of the times’ end that the ninth chapter named.
proposals.summary: Remove imperative staging and digitise the 490 count.
proposals.rationale: “Set that” functions as residual presenter cue akin to forbidden “Mark that/Hold that”; the rewrite keeps exact meaning and also converts the count to digits.

proposals.old: And that scene waits at the end of every count.
proposals.new: This scene waits at the end of every count.
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not open with And/But/That; “This scene” preserves reference and rhythm without the violation.
